notes: 97 passed / 15 failed / 2 flaky / 11 skipped in one full run (29.7 min) on the merged build — web, mobile and cli-api together. The 15 failures are one external cause (a foreign anchor on the shared dev chain), not product behaviour; the two flakes (AZ-044 ECONNRESET, AZ-092) passed on retry.

The 11 skips are the 10 teach-mode lifecycle tests that cannot complete on a node whose stub trainer is measured against a live model or whose announce would be permanent, plus AZ-092 under the `mobile` project (it runs for real at 360 px under `web`).
The demo cluster now serves from its own vLLM (:8002, mailbox ple_patch_e2e, GPUs 4,5); the suite reads the instance and mailbox from node-a's config.

Global setup/teardown assert the cluster is left as it was found: the public catalog is still exactly the four demo knowledges, nothing is loaded in the shared model, node-a's teach policy and peer list are unchanged.

Sixteen audit findings from the previous green run were worked through: fifteen fixed (four in the product), one rejected with a reason (AZ-031 on a private node would replace the scenario, not fix it).
